english.title: Cause to be published an advertisement to sell / buy a live / dead schedule 8 wild plant
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused to be published an advertisement which was likely to be understood as conveying that you would buy or sell, or intended to buy or sell,

(A)_[a live wild plant]_
(B)_[a dead wild plant]_
(C)_[live wild plants]_
(D)_[dead wild plants]_
(E)_[part or parts of or anything derived from a wild plant]_
(F)_[parts of or anything derived from wild plants]_

included in Schedule 8 to the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981, namely **(..SPECIFY SPECIES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 13(2)(b) and 21(1) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 21(7) for place where offence deemed to have been committed for jurisdiction purposes.
(ii) Section 21(5) provides that where more than one animal is involved in a single offence the maximum fine shall be determined as if the person convicted had been convicted of a separate offence in respect of each.
(iii) See also offence wording H4528.
(iv) See Section 27 for meaning of "advertisement", "sale" and "wild plant".
(v) As amended by paragraph 10 of Schedule 12 to the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.
(vi) See Section 21(6) for the forfeiture provisions.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

Where more than one plant is involved in a single offence the maximum fine shall be determined as if the person convicted had been convicted of a separate offence in respect of each plant (Section 21(5)).

Complex - see legislation
